tag: 學會發表 · 試驗讀出
body: Alterity Therapeutics 於 MDS 2026 國際大會（首爾）發表 ATH434-201（Ph2，NCT05109091）新分析：以基線腦脊髓液神經絲輕鏈（CSF NfL）為共變項、事後調整之分析顯示，50mg 劑量組第52週 11項 UMSARS Part I 相對安慰劑差距 4.64 分（p=0.032），公司稱約為「減緩52%功能惡化」；75mg 未達統計顯著。基線 NfL 每升高 1000 pg/mL，與約多 0.9 分惡化相關（p=0.033）。影像面：齒狀核鐵含量於 50mg 組不降反升（+0.016 ppm，p=0.021）。
note: → 需同時指出：此 Ph2 原訂主要終點（第52週黑質鐵含量，MRI）並未達成，本次與先前公布之正面數字均來自次要／探索性或事後調整分析，本站已同步更正在研療法全景之敘述並附上完整脈絡，詳見試驗結果雷達。

en.body: Alterity Therapeutics presented new analyses of ATH434-201 (Ph2, NCT05109091) at the MDS 2026 International Congress (Seoul): a post-hoc analysis adjusted for baseline cerebrospinal fluid neurofilament light chain (CSF NfL) as a covariate showed the 50 mg arm with a 4.64-point difference versus placebo on the 11-item UMSARS Part I at Week 52 (p=0.032), which the company describes as roughly '52% slower functional decline'; the 75 mg arm did not reach significance. Each 1,000 pg/mL increase in baseline NfL was associated with about 0.9 additional points of worsening (p=0.033). On imaging, dentate nucleus iron rose rather than fell in the 50 mg group (+0.016 ppm, p=0.021).
en.note: → It should also be noted that this Phase 2 trial's original primary endpoint (substantia nigra iron at Week 52, by MRI) was not met; both today's and previously publicised positive figures come from secondary/exploratory or post-hoc adjusted analyses. This site has updated the Therapy Landscape entry accordingly with full context; see the Trial Results radar for detail.

body: Lundbeck 公告將於 MDS 2026 國際大會（首爾，2026/10/04–08）發表旗下動作障礙藥物線多項資料，MSA 相關部分包括：①樞紐 Ph3 MASCOT 試驗（amlenetug／Lu AF82422，NCT06706622）收案人群多樣性之基線特徵（Late-breaking oral，10/5），確認收案 401 人、涵蓋 MSA-C 與 MSA-P 兩亞型，72 週雙盲安慰劑對照、主要讀出預計 2027 Q3；②mUMSARS Part I 量表之心理計量驗證、及其中文版驗證（ePoster 149／150，10/5）；③以質譜蛋白體學尋找候選腦脊髓液生物標記（ePoster 121），及一項以 C 端 α-突觸核蛋白檢測區分 MSA 與帕金森氏症之口頭報告（OPP3-G）；④一項美國健保資料庫觀察性研究，發現 MSA 病人之醫療資源使用與支出顯著高於帕金森氏症病人。
note: → 本次公告為研討會議程預告，非試驗結果讀出：MASCOT 的基線多樣性描述不含任何療效或安全性數據；amlenetug 的主要療效結果仍待 2027 Q3。生物標記與量表驗證項目目前僅公告將發表，具體數值待會議現場公布後再補。

en.body: Lundbeck announced it will present multiple movement-disorder pipeline updates at the MDS 2026 International Congress (Seoul, 2026/10/04–08). The MSA-related items include: (1) baseline characteristics describing participant diversity in the pivotal Phase III MASCOT trial (amlenetug / Lu AF82422, NCT06706622) (late-breaking oral, 10/5), confirming 401 participants enrolled, spanning both the MSA-C and MSA-P subtypes, in a 72-week double-blind, placebo-controlled design with the primary readout expected in Q3 2027; (2) psychometric validation of the modified UMSARS Part I scale and of its Chinese-language version (ePosters 149/150, 10/5); (3) candidate cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers identified via mass-spectrometry proteomics (ePoster 121), plus an oral presentation on a C-terminal alpha-synuclein assay to differentiate MSA from Parkinson's disease (OPP3-G); (4) a US claims-database observational study finding significantly higher healthcare resource use and costs among MSA patients compared with Parkinson's disease patients.
en.note: → This announcement is a congress-agenda preview, not a trial readout: the MASCOT baseline/diversity description contains no efficacy or safety data, and amlenetug's primary efficacy result remains pending for Q3 2027. The biomarker and scale-validation items are announced only as forthcoming presentations; specific figures will be added once presented at the congress.

tag: 法規 · 孤兒藥資格申請
body: Tiziana Life Sciences 向 FDA 遞交鼻噴 foralumab 治療 MSA 之孤兒藥資格（Orphan Drug Designation）申請。申請理由為 MSA 在美國患病人數低於 20 萬人之罕病門檻、目前無任何 FDA 核准之疾病修飾療法。申請中引述之支持資料為仍在進行中的 Ph2a 開放標籤試驗（NCT06868628），另援引 foralumab 於非活動性次發進展型多發性硬化症擴大使用計畫中 14 名病人於 6 個月內皆呈現改善或穩定之結果（不同疾病、非 MSA 數據）。公司執行長 Ivor Elrifi 稱 foralumab 可「誘導調節性 T 細胞、調控 T 細胞驅動發炎」並「降低微膠細胞活化」。⚠️ 此為資格（designation）申請，非核准（approval）、亦非試驗療效讀出；孤兒藥資格本身不代表療效獲證實，僅賦予核准後 7 年市場獨佔、臨床試驗稅務抵免、申請費減免與 FDA 協助輔導等資格利益；審查結果尚待 FDA 公告。
note: → MSA 目前尚無任何已獲 FDA 孤兒藥資格之療法達到核准階段；本項申請本身不改變 foralumab 的臨床階段（仍為 Ph2a、累計僅 3 名 MSA 受試者有公開 PET 數據，見在研療法全景）。

en.body: Tiziana Life Sciences has filed with the FDA for Orphan Drug Designation for intranasal foralumab in MSA. The filing cites MSA's US prevalence below the 200,000-patient rare-disease threshold and the absence of any FDA-approved disease-modifying therapy. The supporting data cited is the still-ongoing open-label Phase 2a trial (NCT06868628), alongside foralumab results from an expanded-access programme in non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis in which 14 patients showed either improvement or stability within 6 months (a different disease, not MSA data). CEO Ivor Elrifi stated foralumab 'induces regulatory T cells and modulates T-cell-driven inflammation' while 'reducing microglial activation'. ⚠️ This is a designation filing, not an approval and not a trial efficacy readout; orphan designation itself does not establish efficacy — it confers eligibility for 7 years of market exclusivity upon approval, clinical-testing tax credits, application-fee waivers and FDA protocol assistance; the outcome of FDA review is still pending.
en.note: → No MSA therapy with FDA orphan drug designation has yet reached approval; this filing by itself does not change foralumab's clinical stage (still Phase 2a, with publicly reported PET data from only 3 MSA participants to date — see the competitive landscape page).

dateDisplay: 2025/10 財報揭露 · 2026/03 AD/PD 完整發表
tag: 試驗讀出 · 主動盤點新收錄
body: 武田／AstraZeneca 的 TAK-341（MEDI1341，anti-α-synuclein 單株抗體）樞紐性 Ph2（NCT05526391）確認失敗、開發終止。試驗為隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，每 4 週靜脈輸注一次，於北美／歐洲／亞洲 56 站點收案 159 人，2025/07 完成；主要指標為第 52 週 Modified UMSARS 分數變化。武田於 2025/10/31 第三季財報文件中揭露主要與次要終點均未達統計顯著，並將 TAK-341 自產品線移除；完整數據其後於 2026/03 AD/PD 國際大會發表，結果為安全性可耐受、但治療組與安慰劑組無顯著差異。本站先前未收錄此資產與此試驗，本次為主動盤點（active discovery）後首次收錄。
note: → 這是繼 Biohaven verdiperstat（M-STAR Ph3，2021）與 Ionis/Biogen ION464（2025）後，MSA 領域第三個由大型藥廠終止的 anti-α-synuclein／抗神經退化資產。⚠️ 本次掃描期間 ClinicalTrials.gov、PubMed 與多數新聞網域遭組織層級網路政策阻擋（HTTP 403），本站無法直接讀取武田財報原文或 AD/PD 海報全文，以上僅根據可透過搜尋索引到之 FierceBiotech、AlzForum、Neurology 摘要頁等次級來源彙整；具體 UMSARS 數值尚未見於本站可查證之公開索引摘要中列出，本站不代填。

en.tag: Trial readout · newly added via active discovery
en.body: Takeda/AstraZeneca's TAK-341 (MEDI1341, an anti-alpha-synuclein monoclonal antibody) pivotal Ph2 (NCT05526391) has been confirmed a failure and the programme discontinued. The trial was randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, with IV infusions every 4 weeks, enrolling 159 patients across 56 sites in North America, Europe and Asia, completing in 2025/07; the primary endpoint was change in Modified UMSARS at week 52. Takeda disclosed in its 2025/10/31 Q3 earnings materials that neither the primary nor secondary endpoints were met and removed TAK-341 from its pipeline; full data were subsequently presented at the 2026/03 AD/PD International Conference, showing the drug was safe and well tolerated but with no significant difference versus placebo. This site had not previously tracked this asset or trial; it is added here following active discovery.
en.note: → The third large-pharma anti-alpha-synuclein/anti-neurodegenerative asset halted in MSA, after Biohaven's verdiperstat (M-STAR Ph3, 2021) and Ionis/Biogen's ION464 (2025). ⚠️ During this scan, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed and most news domains were blocked by an organisation-level network policy (HTTP 403), so this site could not directly read Takeda's earnings filing or the AD/PD poster; the above is compiled from secondary sources indexed via search — FierceBiotech, AlzForum, a Neurology abstract page — and specific UMSARS figures are not yet available from a source this site could verify, so none are supplied.

body: 小野藥品 ONO-2808（S1P5 促效劑）樞紐性 Ph3 試驗（NCT07825402）於 2026/09/17 登錄 CT.gov，尚未開始收案：隨機雙盲安慰劑對照、口服、限 MSA-P 亞型、療程 48 週，估計 2027/01 開始收案、2029/10 主要完成。承接 2026/05 WPC 發表之 Ph2 核心數據（MSA-P 次族群 mUMSARS 變化：安慰劑 3.90 vs 高劑量 1.16）。
note: → 登錄未載入組人數與收案地點，屬 Ph2→Ph3 銜接的正式里程碑，非新療效數據。

en.body: Ono's ONO-2808 (S1P5 agonist) pivotal Ph3 trial (NCT07825402) was registered on CT.gov on 2026/09/17 and is not yet recruiting: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, oral, restricted to the MSA-P subtype, 48-week treatment; estimated start 2027/01 and primary completion 2029/10. It follows the Ph2 core data presented at WPC in 2026/05 (MSA-P subgroup mUMSARS change: 3.90 placebo vs 1.16 high dose).
en.note: → The registration does not yet give enrollment size or sites; this is a formal Ph2-to-Ph3 milestone, not new efficacy data.

body: Alterity ATH434 取得美國專利商標局新核准的物質組成專利：保護範圍為 ATH434甲磺酸鹽的特定結晶型，並涵蓋以該結晶型治療神經疾病的方法。公司表示此專利將保護期延長至至少 2045 年（自核准日起逾 18 年），且此結晶型即為 Ph2 MSA 試驗所用、亦將用於規劃中的 Ph3。
note: → 這是專利事項、非臨床或法規進展，本身不構成療效或安全性訊息。與 2026/07 的 FDA End-of-Phase-2 註冊路徑一併參照，反映該案正在為公司稱 2026 年底啟動的 Ph3 作業鋪路。公司另稱此專利有利於未來拓展至帕金森病等涉及鐵代謝失衡與蛋白聚集的疾病。新聞稿未載專利號。

en.body: Alterity's ATH434 has been granted a new US composition-of-matter patent by the USPTO, covering a specific crystalline form of the mesylate salt of ATH434 together with methods of treating neurological conditions using it. The company states the patent extends protection to at least 2045 — more than 18 years from the grant date — and that this is the form used in the Ph2 MSA trials and intended for the planned Ph3.
en.note: → This is an intellectual-property matter rather than clinical or regulatory progress, and carries no information about efficacy or safety in itself. Read alongside the FDA End-of-Phase-2 registrational pathway of July 2026, it reflects groundwork for the Ph3 activities the company says will begin by the end of 2026. The company also states the patent supports future development in Parkinson's disease and other conditions involving disturbed iron handling and protein aggregation. The release does not give a patent number.
